brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Jewish voices in Western countries are adopting anti-Zionist positions as Israel's global standing weakens. The shift comes amid significant changes in public opinion across multiple nations, according to commentary submitted by Awad Abdelfattah.

The report suggests Palestinians should capitalize on this moment of changing attitudes toward Israeli policies and ideology among Jewish communities in the West.

title: Western Jewish activists increasingly embrace anti-Zionism
